def slug(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", str(text).lower()).strip("_")


def unit_class(unit: str | None, name: str) -> str | None:
    u = (unit or "").strip()
    if u in ("W", "kW"):
        return "power"
    if u in ("Wh", "kWh"):
        return "energy"
    if u == "%" and re.search(r"charge|soc", name, re.I):
        return "battery"
    return {"V": "voltage", "A": "current", "°C": "temperature", "Hz": "frequency"}.get(u)


class SolarAssistant(Device):
    platform = "solar_assistant"
    manufacturer = "Growatt"
    model = "SPH"

    def __init__(self, host: str, password: str = "", family: str = "growatt_sph", name: str = "Growatt SPH",
                 model: str = "SPH 3600", manufacturer: str = "Growatt", mapping: dict[str, str] | None = None,
                 transport: Callable[[], Any] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__("solar_assistant_1", name)
        self.host, self.password, self.family = host.strip(), password, family
        self.model, self.manufacturer = model, manufacturer
        self.prefix = slug(name)
        self.mapping = dict(mapping or {})
        self.transport = transport or WebSocket
        self.ws: Any = None
        self.defs: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}  # every topic SolarAssistant has sent (shown in the app)
        self.values: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.topic_entity: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.entity_topic: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.kind: dict[str, tuple[str, Any]] = {}
        self.pending: dict[str, asyncio.Future] = {}
        self.status = "ikke forbundet"
        self.last_data = 0.0
        self._ref = 0
        self._task: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self._make_entities()

    # ---- entities ----

    def _make_entities(self) -> None:
        for topic, (key, unit, dc) in TOTALS.items():
            sc = "total_increasing" if dc == "energy" else "measurement"
            eid = self.entity(f"sensor.{self.prefix}_{key}", key.replace("_", " ").capitalize(), unit, dc, sc)
            self.topic_entity[topic] = eid
            self.entity_topic[eid] = topic
        for key, (domain, spec) in SETTINGS.get(self.family, {}).items():
            extra: dict[str, Any] = {}
            if domain == "select":
                extra["options"] = list(spec)
            elif domain == "number":
                extra.update(min=spec[0], max=spec[1], step=1, mode="box")
            eid = self.entity(f"{domain}.{self.prefix}_{key}", key.replace("_", " ").capitalize(),
                              "%" if domain == "number" else None, **extra)
            topic = self.mapping.get(key) or f"inverter_1/{key}"
            self.topic_entity[topic] = eid
            self.entity_topic[eid] = topic
            self.kind[eid] = (domain, spec)

    def _entity_for_new_topic(self, topic: str, d: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
        """Any other number SolarAssistant sends becomes a sensor too (temperatures, voltages …)."""
        if topic in self.topic_entity:
            return self.topic_entity[topic]
        key = slug(topic.split("/", 1)[1] if topic.startswith("inverter_1/") else topic)
        eid = f"sensor.{self.prefix}_{key}"
        if eid in self.entities:
            return None
        unit = d.get("unit") or None
        self.entity(eid, d.get("name") or key, unit, unit_class(unit, d.get("name") or key))
        self.topic_entity[topic] = eid
        self.entity_topic[eid] = topic
        return eid

    # ---- connection ----

    def attach(self, ha: Any) -> None:
        super().attach(ha)
        for eid in self.entities:
            self.ha.publish(eid, "unavailable", self.entities[eid])
        self._task = asyncio.ensure_future(self._run())

    def _url(self) -> str:
        host = self.host
        if "://" not in host:
            host = "ws://" + host
        from urllib.parse import quote
        return f"{host.rstrip('/')}/api/websocket?password={quote(self.password)}"

    async def _run(self) -> None:
        delay = 2.0
        while True:
            try:
                self.status = "forbinder…"
                self.ws = self.transport()
                await self.ws.connect(self._url())
                self.status = "forbundet"
                delay = 2.0
                await self._send("join", {"topics": [{"topic": "*"}]})
                while True:
                    raw = await self.ws.recv()
                    if raw is None:
                        break
                    self._on_message(raw)
            except (NetError, OSError, asyncio.TimeoutError) as err:
                self.status = f"kan ikke forbinde: {err}"
                _LOGGER.warning("SolarAssistant %s: %s", self.host, err)
            except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001
                self.status = f"fejl: {err}"
                _LOGGER.warning("SolarAssistant failed", exc_info=True)
            self.online = False
            for eid in self.entities:
                self.ha.publish(eid, "unavailable", self.entities[eid])
            try:
                await self.ws.close()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            delay = min(60.0, delay * 2)

    async def _send(self, event: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        self._ref += 1
        ref = str(self._ref)
        await self.ws.send(json.dumps({"topic": "metrics", "event": event, "payload": payload, "ref": ref}))
        return ref

    def _on_message(self, raw: str) -> None:
        try:
            msg = json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:
            return
        ev, p = msg.get("event"), msg.get("payload") or {}
        if ev == "definition":
            for d in p.get("definitions") or [p]:
                t = d.get("topic")
                if t:
                    self.defs[t] = d
                    self._entity_for_new_topic(t, d)
        elif ev == "data":
            self.online = True
            self.last_data = time.time()
            for m in p.get("metrics") or [p]:
                t = m.get("topic")
                if t is None:
                    continue
                self.values[t] = m.get("value")
                eid = self.topic_entity.get(t) or self._entity_for_new_topic(t, self.defs.get(t, {}))
                if eid:
                    self.set(eid, self._to_state(eid, m.get("value")))
        elif ev == "set_result":
            fut = self.pending.pop(p.get("topic"), None)
            if fut and not fut.done():
                fut.set_result(p)

    def _to_state(self, eid: str, value: Any) -> Any:
        domain = self.kind.get(eid, ("sensor", None))[0]
        if domain == "switch":
            return "on" if str(value).strip().lower() in ("enabled", "on", "true", "1", "yes") else "off"
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            return "on" if value else "off"
        return value

    def _to_value(self, eid: str, value: Any) -> str:
        """Our value -> what SolarAssistant expects, in the same form it reports the setting."""
        domain = self.kind.get(eid, ("sensor", None))[0]
        if domain == "switch":
            on = value == "on"
            cur = str(self.values.get(self.entity_topic.get(eid), "")).strip()
            if cur.lower() in ("true", "false"):
                return "true" if on else "false"
            if cur.lower() in ("on", "off"):
                return "on" if on else "off"
            if cur in ("1", "0"):
                return "1" if on else "0"
            return "Enabled" if on else "Disabled"
        if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
            value = int(value)
        return str(value)

    async def write(self, entity_id: str, value: Any) -> None:
        topic = self.entity_topic.get(entity_id)
        if not topic or not self.ws or not self.ws.open:
            raise RuntimeError(f"SolarAssistant er ikke forbundet ({self.status})")
        sa_value = self._to_value(entity_id, value)
        fut: asyncio.Future = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
        self.pending[topic] = fut
        await self._send("set", {"topic": topic, "value": sa_value, "verify": True})
        try:
            res = await asyncio.wait_for(fut, 90)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError as err:
            self.pending.pop(topic, None)
            raise RuntimeError(f"SolarAssistant svarede ikke på {topic}") from err
        if res.get("result") != "ok":
            raise RuntimeError(f"SolarAssistant: {topic} = {sa_value}: {res.get('message') or res.get('result')}")
        if self.kind.get(entity_id, ("",))[0] == "number":
            value = float(value)
            value = int(value) if value.is_integer() else value
        self.values[topic] = sa_value
        self.set(entity_id, value)

    async def refresh(self, dt: float) -> None:
        if self.online and self.last_data and time.time() - self.last_data > 120:
            self.status = "ingen data i 2 minutter"

    def info(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"status": self.status, "host": self.host,
                "topics": [{"topic": t, "name": d.get("name"), "unit": d.get("unit"), "group": d.get("group"),
                            "value": self.values.get(t), "entity": self.topic_entity.get(t)} for t, d in sorted(self.defs.items())],
                "missing": [e for e, t in self.entity_topic.items() if e in self.kind and t not in self.defs and t not in self.values]}

    def energy_prefs(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

"""Network for the device drivers: WebSocket and UDP, in the app and on a normal computer.

In the app (Pyodide): WebSocket is the WebView's own; UDP goes through the app's native plugin (window.EPNative,
see android/EpUdpPlugin.java) - a WebView can't send UDP itself.
On a computer (tools/dev_server.py, tests): asyncio - so the drivers can be tried against the real devices from a PC.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import base64
import os
import socket
import struct
import sys
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

IN_APP = sys.platform == "emscripten"


class NetError(Exception):
    pass


# ---------------- UDP ----------------

class _UdpCatcher(asyncio.DatagramProtocol):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.q: asyncio.Queue[tuple[bytes, Any]] = asyncio.Queue()

    def datagram_received(self, data: bytes, addr: Any) -> None:
        self.q.put_nowait((data, addr))


_udp_lock: asyncio.Lock | None = None


async def udp_request(host: str, port: int, message: str, timeout: float = 3.0, local_port: int | None = None,
                      expect_reply: bool = True) -> str:
    """Send one UDP message and wait for the answer from that host. KEBA answers to port 7090 on the sender, so the
    local port can be fixed (local_port)."""
    if IN_APP:
        try:
            from js import EPNative  # type: ignore
        except ImportError as err:
            raise NetError("UDP kræver Android-appen") from err
        if not getattr(EPNative, "udp", False):
            raise NetError("UDP kræver Android-appen (ikke browseren)")
        try:
            r = await EPNative.udpRequest(host, port, message, int(timeout * 1000), local_port or 0, expect_reply)
        except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001 - the plugin rejects with a JS error (timeout, unreachable …)
            raise NetError(str(err)) from err
        if r is None:
            raise NetError("intet svar")
        return str(r)
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    global _udp_lock
    if _udp_lock is None:
        _udp_lock = asyncio.Lock()
    async with _udp_lock:
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        sock.bind(("0.0.0.0", local_port or 0))
        transport, proto = await loop.create_datagram_endpoint(_UdpCatcher, sock=sock)
        try:
            transport.sendto(message.encode(), (host, port))
            if not expect_reply:
                return ""
            end = loop.time() + timeout
            while True:
                left = end - loop.time()
                if left <= 0:
                    raise NetError(f"intet svar fra {host}")
                try:
                    data, addr = await asyncio.wait_for(proto.q.get(), left)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError as err:
                    raise NetError(f"intet svar fra {host}") from err
                if addr[0] == socket.gethostbyname(host):
                    return data.decode(errors="replace")
        finally:
            transport.close()


# ---------------- WebSocket ----------------

class WebSocket:
    """A text WebSocket: connect(), send(), recv(), close()."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._q: asyncio.Queue[str | None] = asyncio.Queue()
        self.open = False
        self._js: Any = None
        self._proxies: list[Any] = []
        self._reader: asyncio.StreamReader | None = None
        self._writer: asyncio.StreamWriter | None = None
        self._task: asyncio.Task | None = None

    async def connect(self, url: str, timeout: float = 10.0) -> None:
        if IN_APP:
            await self._connect_js(url, timeout)
        else:
            await asyncio.wait_for(self._connect_tcp(url), timeout)
        self.open = True

    # -- in the app: the WebView's WebSocket --
    async def _connect_js(self, url: str, timeout: float) -> None:
        from js import WebSocket as JsWebSocket  # type: ignore
        from pyodide.ffi import create_proxy  # type: ignore

        opened: asyncio.Future = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()

        def on_open(_e: Any) -> None:
            if not opened.done():
                opened.set_result(True)

        def on_message(e: Any) -> None:
            self._q.put_nowait(str(e.data))

        def on_close(_e: Any) -> None:
            self.open = False
            self._q.put_nowait(None)
            if not opened.done():
                opened.set_exception(NetError("forbindelsen blev afvist"))

        ws = JsWebSocket.new(url)
        for name, fn in (("onopen", on_open), ("onmessage", on_message), ("onclose", on_close), ("onerror", on_close)):
            p = create_proxy(fn)
            self._proxies.append(p)
            setattr(ws, name, p)
        self._js = ws
        await asyncio.wait_for(opened, timeout)

    # -- on a computer: a small client over asyncio (text frames, ping/pong) --
    async def _connect_tcp(self, url: str) -> None:
        u = urlsplit(url)
        port = u.port or (443 if u.scheme == "wss" else 80)
        reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection(u.hostname, port, ssl=(u.scheme == "wss") or None)
        key = base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16)).decode()
        path = (u.path or "/") + (("?" + u.query) if u.query else "")
        writer.write((f"GET {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {u.hostname}:{port}\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\n"
                      f"Sec-WebSocket-Key: {key}\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n\r\n").encode())
        await writer.drain()
        status = await reader.readline()
        if b" 101 " not in status:
            raise NetError(f"WebSocket afvist: {status.decode(errors='replace').strip()}")
        while (await reader.readline()) not in (b"\r\n", b""):
            pass
        self._reader, self._writer = reader, writer
        self._task = asyncio.ensure_future(self._read_loop())

    async def _read_loop(self) -> None:
        r = self._reader
        buf = b""
        try:
            while True:
                head = await r.readexactly(2)
                fin, op = head[0] & 0x80, head[0] & 0x0F
                n = head[1] & 0x7F
                if n == 126:
                    n = struct.unpack(">H", await r.readexactly(2))[0]
                elif n == 127:
                    n = struct.unpack(">Q", await r.readexactly(8))[0]
                mask = await r.readexactly(4) if head[1] & 0x80 else None
                data = await r.readexactly(n)
                if mask:
                    data = bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(data))
                if op == 0x8:
                    break
                if op == 0x9:
                    self._frame(0xA, data)
                    continue
                if op in (0x1, 0x2, 0x0):
                    buf += data
                    if fin:
                        self._q.put_nowait(buf.decode(errors="replace"))
                        buf = b""
        except (asyncio.IncompleteReadError, ConnectionError, OSError):
            pass
        self.open = False
        self._q.put_nowait(None)

    def _frame(self, op: int, data: bytes) -> None:
        mask = os.urandom(4)
        n = len(data)
        head = bytes([0x80 | op])
        if n < 126:
            head += bytes([0x80 | n])
        elif n < 65536:
            head += bytes([0x80 | 126]) + struct.pack(">H", n)
        else:
            head += bytes([0x80 | 127]) + struct.pack(">Q", n)
        self._writer.write(head + mask + bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(data)))

    async def send(self, text: str) -> None:
        if not self.open:
            raise NetError("ikke forbundet")
        if IN_APP:
            self._js.send(text)
        else:
            self._frame(0x1, text.encode())
            await self._writer.drain()

    async def recv(self) -> str | None:
        """The next message, or None when the connection is closed."""
        return await self._q.get()

    async def close(self) -> None:
        self.open = False
        try:
            if IN_APP and self._js is not None:
                self._js.close()
            elif self._writer is not None:
                self._frame(0x8, b"")
                self._writer.close()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        for p in self._proxies:
            try:
                p.destroy()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        self._proxies.clear()
